name: segue
description: Compaction that continues without a break: writes a handoff card before /compact and auto-compact, summarises on Haiku, and tells the agent to carry on from the card. Falls back to the built-in summary on any failure.

model.title: Summary model
model.description: Model that writes the summary and the handoff card. The session's own model is not changed.

handoffDir.title: Handoff folder
handoffDir.description: Folder the handoff cards are written to. A leading ~/ is the home directory.

censusCommand.title: Census command
censusCommand.description: Shell command whose output is given to the summary model as the machine's state. Empty: the built-in git census (branch, uncommitted files, worktrees, recent commits, stashes).
